verdict.rationale: An in-product AI insights feature is a fair question for an e-commerce platform, but the evidence pack documents none. The native MCP support lets external AI assistants interact with the store, which is a different capability and earns no credit here. Nothing shows AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced from store data inside WooCommerce itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
